================================================================================
Query: Semantic + Filters - HNSW Recall Test
================================================================================

        EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
        SELECT id, sentence_text, chapter_number
        FROM sentences
        WHERE book = 'El Filibusterismo'
          AND source_type = 'summary'
